question: Where can I find a fast food restaurant that are within 60 kilometers and lie northeast of Holiday Inn & Suites Joliet Southwest, Joliet, IL?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-88.170817 41.495612)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-88.170817 41.495612)',4326)::geography, 60000)
AND amenity = 'fast_food'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5;
